risks.title: Dependence on single ethylene oxide supplier in the United States
risks.score_rationale: Risk is rated critical (5) as the company depends on a single ethylene oxide supplier in the United States, critical material for Sterigenics sterilization operations. The 10-K explicitly highlights supply disruption risks with material adverse impact. Absence of immediate alternatives increases operational vulnerability. This risk remains stable versus prior year.

risks.title: Cobalt-60 supply risk from Russia
risks.score_rationale: Risk is rated 5 as up to 50% of cobalt-60 supply could come from Russian reactors. The 10-K explicitly cites geopolitical sanctions, logistical restrictions and license renewal challenges as major threats to the Nordion segment. Language emphasizes material adverse impact. Geopolitical category is highly critical. This risk is increasing in intensity and urgency.

risks.title: Ongoing litigation for ethylene oxide emissions and health impacts
risks.score_rationale: Risk is rated 5 as the company faces current litigation for ethylene oxide emissions causing or alleging health impacts. The 10-K text mentions substantial claims and significant liability risk. Language is repetitive and alarming. Litigation category is heavily weighted in systemic risk cases. This risk is reinforced or new in the current period.

risks.title: Increasing regulations on ethylene oxide and alternatives
risks.score_rationale: Risk is rated 4 as FDA and other regulators push toward ethylene oxide alternatives, with recent hydrogen peroxide approval. This threatens future demand for EO sterilization services. The 10-K indicates material impact but the company is already investing in alternative solutions and environmental improvements (24.4M$ in 2025, 51M$ expected in 2026). Regulation category is critical. Risk is increasing with environmental and health regulations.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and dependence on IT systems
risks.score_rationale: Risk is rated 4 as the company heavily relies on its IT systems for critical operations, and the 10-K cites cybersecurity incidents as direct threats to operational continuity. While language is measured, operational dependence is strong. Cybersecurity category is strategic for an essential services company. This risk is stable with no indication of material change.

risks.title: Emerging risks related to artificial intelligence integration
risks.score_rationale: Risk is rated 3 as AI is mentioned as an emerging technology risk in the 10-K, but without concrete details on potential impact or operational integration. Language is cautious but not alarming. Technology category is moderately critical in the services context. This risk is new or recently identified.

risks.title: High leverage and financial flexibility constraints
risks.score_rationale: Risk is rated 4 as the company carries significant debt with 1,419.5M$ in term loans and 750M$ in senior secured notes due 2031, limiting financial flexibility and ability to respond to economic or operational shocks. The 10-K explicitly mentions risk of inability to meet obligations. Capital category is highly critical. This risk remains stable with well-defined debt structure and 2025 refinancing.

ai_positioning.summary: SHC does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning as a strategic element in its 10-K/20-F filing. AI is mentioned only as a potential emerging risk without operational detail.
